answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ember of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The sonnet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the wander. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
